Redfish Validator? What tests?
Yeah, would like to see some more details on testing. Use busctl to manually move the dbus properties to the Transitioning states and verify the Redfish API's.

Sorry, was obvious to me as I was discovered this working on official OpenBMC tests - https://github.com/openbmc/openbmc-test-automation/. Tests using reboot failed on BMC that exposes the TransitioningToOff/TransitioningToOn statuses. It's not particular test, as it fails on power management operation. This is the reason behind this - the way the power operation in the openbmc-test-automation tests works - it has 2 states current and desired states, after it performed operation, it periodically collects current state and compares with desired, until it matches (success) or timeout (failure). The state looks like:
```
state:
  [redfish]:                                      1
  [chassis]:                                      On
  [host]:                                         Disabled
  [bmc]:                                          Enabled
  [boot_progress]:                                None
```

In order to collect Chassis state, tests do `Redfish.Get Properties    /redfish/v1/Chassis/${CHASSIS_ID}` and then consume `${chassis["PowerState"]}    ${chassis["Status"]["State"]}`.

So, the problem was, when DBUS reports state as TransitioningToOff or TransitioningToOn, the code simple ignored them, and did not populate the fields. As tests expected these fields to be populated, it simple failed the test as it could not construct valid state object.

I ran the test suite against BMC with my change, and it stopped failing tests as the fields were populated and tests could construct and consume the state object.

The dbus properties have been moved by the tests (and revealed the problem). Do you still want me to use busctl to manually move?

> Do you still want me to use busctl to manually move?

If you can, at a minimum, please add more to the commit msg like below. Ideally you would also run the redfish validator but since we moved to enums, it is pretty unlikely the validator got broke. 

Can you add a bit of this to the commit msg? Something like 

Tested: Robot tests testing power operations now pass, before when the D-Bus state was TransitioningToOff or TransitioningToOn they would error.

I always forget about the validator. Just ran this version on test BMC, made it into transitioning (PoweringOff) state, and ran the validator. It succeeded.

Let me update the commit message.

I don't see an opposite of Starting so StandbyOffline seems fine. Enabled could have also worked here. Maybe something like UnavailableOffline would also work but PowerState is what is most important here and it says PoweringOff.
